description: Give the boot smoke test suites a 30 s time budget above the script's bounded waits, so that a slow CI runner does not time out a correct case.

userStories.title: Set a time budget on the boot smoke test suites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a test budget above the longest script wait, so that a slow CI runner passes a correct case.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/scripts/__tests__/sandbox-boot-smoke.test.ts` declares one named constant for the test time budget, with the value `30_000`.
Both `describe` blocks in the file pass the constant as their `timeout` option.
The case "fails when systemd does not recover the scheduler after SIGKILL" still asserts exit status 1 and the stderr text `did not recover the scheduler after SIGKILL`.
With the `kill -9` stub changed to always write `4242`, the case above fails. The advisor runs this mutation check and reverts the stub.
`pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/sandbox-boot-smoke.test.ts` exits 0 on 20 consecutive runs.
